answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new agent to lock a small refundable bond that only unlocks after established peers attest to real completed work. A fresh identity cannot simply multiply: each copy must fund its own bond and earn its own attestations, so a gale of fake accounts quickly runs out of capital. Like shale laid down layer by layer, reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be faked in bulk, and any agent caught gaming the system loses its bond and carries a violet flag visible to future partners.
